name: ironwood-like
description: Ironwood-like endpoint exactly as Panel-Scale-Systems/src/configs/ironwood_chip_endpoint_v1.json (one endpoint = one chip, two chiplets aggregated; chiplet-faithful placement and D2D timing not claimed). Collective arithmetic is treated as offloaded and not charged to the tensor cores, as in the campaign.

compute.model: time = max(flops / (peak * achieved_fraction), bytes / hbm_bandwidth) + kernel_floor

dma.notes: no separate DMA model in G4

notes: The endpoint JSON's link figures (6 ports x 200 GB/s, 1000 ns) belong to the FabricSpec, not here: a HardwareSpec never implies a fabric.
